request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Recolour only two things. The two red patches beside his cheeks become olive green ears. His yellow-green skin (face, ears, shoulders) becomes a mid-tone olive green, colour #8a952f with #495508 shadows; no red left except his tongue, and the face stays clearly visible. Keep everything else exactly the same: the rusted pot helmet and goggles, the bomb with its yellow stripes and spark, the brown strap, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
